udp_port.description: UDP port on which rsyslog listens for incoming syslog messages.

udp_address.description: IP address to bind the UDP listener to (e.g., `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces, or `127.0.0.1` for local-only).

tcp_enabled.description: Enable TCP input in addition to UDP for receiving syslog messages.

tcp_port.description: TCP port to use if TCP input is enabled.

tcp_address.description: IP address to bind the TCP listener to if enabled.

log_rules.description: List of rsyslog routing rules (selector + action). Each rule defines how matched messages are processed.

selector.description: Syslog selector (e.g., `*.info`, `authpriv.*`, `=warn`) followed by optional facility priority modifiers.

action.description: Target action (e.g., file path `/var/log/syslog`, pipe `|/path/to/script`, or special destination `:omusrmsg:;template`)
